_comment: Cryptarithm locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the assignment token `[A 5]`, single letters, or digits.

_slots.{letter}: A puzzle letter, e.g. S or E
_slots.{used_letter}: The letter that already claimed a digit
_slots.{assigned}: How many letters are mapped so far
_slots.{pct}: Progress as a percentage string, e.g. 50%

player_prompt.intro:
Bê mbûni kôko ôko na môni yê kêtê kêtê.
Kîri na `[A 5]`, bîri kwa sô kô.

invalid_move.letter_not_in_puzzle: Tënë {letter} ayeke na yâ ti puzzle ni pëpe.
invalid_move.leading_zero: Kozo chiffre ti mbeni tënë alingbi pëpe ti duti 0.

outcome.correct: A yeke tâ tënë! E lingbi na ni awe.
outcome.incorrect: A sara kusala na carte ni awe me a yeke tâ tënë pëpe.
outcome.limit: A si na ndo so a lingbi ti hon dä.
